name: counterexample-finder
description: Counterexample Finder — find the smallest failing input for any buggy competitive-programming / LeetCode solution. AI writes a brute-force + random tests, the browser verifies.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix app install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix server run dev & npm --prefix app run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix app run build
